# parse matrices from compact rows
A=['..##.#...#.#.','##.#..#..####','#.##..#....#.','##.##.#.#####','###.##.#.#.#.','.###.#.###...','...#####.##.#','##.#..##.#.#.','..#.##...#.##']
B=['#...#.##.#...','...#.##...#..','#..#...#.....','#..#..#..##.#','##....##.#.#.','#.##.#..##...','.###.........','.#...#..#.###','#...#...#....']
O=['.....#.......','...#..#...#..','#..#.........','#..#..#..##.#','##.....#.#.#.','..##.#..##...','...#.........','.#........###','....#........']
def coords(rows): return [[c=='#' for c in r] for r in rows]
A,B,O=map(coords,(A,B,O))
def rot(b):return [list(row) for row in zip(*b[::-1])]
def flip(b):return [r[::-1] for r in b]
ops={'and':lambda a,b:a and b,'or':lambda a,b:a or b,'xor':lambda a,b:a!=b,'Aonly':lambda a,b:a and not b,'Bonly':lambda a,b:b and not a,'A':lambda a,b:a,'B':lambda a,b:b}
for orientation in range(8):
 C=[r[:] for r in B]
 if orientation>=4:C=flip(C)
 for _ in range(orientation%4):C=rot(C)
 if len(C)!=9 or len(C[0])!=13:continue
 scores=[]
 for name,f in ops.items():
  matches=sum(f(A[y][x],C[y][x])==O[y][x] for y in range(9) for x in range(13))
  scores.append((matches,name))
 print(orientation,sorted(scores,reverse=True)[:3])
